chose: Each take's `about` is `{ key, ...per kind }`, from one exhaustive match on Of. The keys are game:<game>, interview:<week>, rust-round:<week or round>, studio:<project>, idea:<idea>, and <kind>:<ref> for the rest. A game's about holds the game's label ('NE @ CHI', from the newest summary home fetched of the game), a nested `bite` and a nested `match` with the play's latest version. An interview answer carries the rung its week's standing send gives it.
options: one key per take, nested game detail
gray: The owner named examples (game, rust-round week and ticket, interview week/question/rung, studio project and shot, or idea) but no key grammar. One key per take keeps the filter a single equality.
